answer: The most convincing sybil defense binds each agent identity to a nonce-chained work history: every completed task is signed with a fresh nonce derived from the previous one, so the ledger forms a single unbranching chain, like a lotus growing one petal at a time. Nodes reject any second branch from the same chain head, the way canyon walls funnel a river into one channel, so identities cannot be forked into parallel copies. A fake identity starts with an empty chain, zero work depth, and must grind through real tasks like an ember
